semantic.justification: Actual CDocument/CNode wrappers now connect the native pointer factory to capture/target/bubble dispatch. Focused genuine graph cases cover source cancellation, UI/mouse/mutation facets, callback map changes and exception ownership. The six-file run passes 56 tests; dispatcher coverage is 98.70% statements, 95% branches and 100% functions/lines. The original CDOMImplementation remains source-unimplemented. Whole DOM coverage, builder, XPath, SAX/IO, compiled C++ threading/ABI, metadata and complete DOCX/XLSX file/UI acceptance remain unverified.
